bill_info.title: Bill settings
bill_info.description: The bill has no login and no fixed polling interval - it's only fetched when you paste that month's link into the 'Bill link' text entity. There is nothing to configure here.

gas_login.title: Gas settings
gas_login.description: Re-enter this if your gas account password changed - it will be re-verified on save. The monthly (1st of month) check time can also be changed here.

data.gas_check_time: Check time (1st of month, HH:MM, default 09:00)

kocom_login.title: Kocom settings
kocom_login.description: Re-enter this if your Kocom password changed - the server address will be looked up again and re-verified on save.

citywaste_login.title: Food waste settings
citywaste_login.description:
Enter your citywaste.or.kr login along with the tag print code/dong/ho needed for the live check (find these on citywaste.or.kr's "나의 수수료 조회" page).

The live check interval (default 1800s/30min) and the last-month settlement check time (1st of each month, HH:MM, default 09:00) can also be changed here.

The very first time it has ever been fetched (not just the first time you save this form - re-entering it later does not redo this), it pulls the last 12 months at once; after that it only re-fetches last month alongside it.

bill_fetch_failed.title: Management bill fetch failed
bill_fetch_failed.description:
Fetching the bill link failed: {error}

If a new bill is out, try pasting that month's link into the 'Bill link' text entity again. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

gas_login_failed.title: GSE city gas login/fetch failed
gas_login_failed.description:
Fetching the gas history failed: {error}

If your password changed, re-enter it under Settings → Options → Gas login. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

kocom_auth_failed.title: Kocom authentication failed
kocom_auth_failed.description:
Authenticating with the Kocom wall-pad server failed: {error}

If your password changed, re-enter it under Settings → Options → Kocom login. This notification clears automatically once a fetch succeeds.

citywaste_login_failed.title: Food waste (citywaste) login/fetch failed
